_description: Native gemini_simulator project file for a geothermal doublet with a degasser and three parallel heat exchangers on the primary loop: producer well (with ESP) -> degasser -> filter -> 3 parallel heat exchangers -> filter -> injector well. Every value here is already in the units gemini_model's components expect (see '_units' below); edit this file directly to describe your own plant.

_units.all components: flow rates in SI [m3/s], pressure [bar] (surface network) or [Pa] (heat exchanger inputs still use bar for pressure -- see each component's own docstring), temperature [C]. The only components still working in m3/h are producer_well/injector_well (well/reservoir models); the surface chain converts to/from m3/h exactly once at each of those two boundaries.

_assumptions._description: Values below were common defaults. reservoir_pressure_bar and productivity_index_m3h_per_bar for the producer well (216 bar, 20.75 m3/h/bar) and reservoir_pressure_bar for the injector well (180 bar) were given, not assumed.
_assumptions.producer_well.parameters.ambient_tempera: 20 C; a typical shallow-formation/near-surface ambient temperature (kept within the 15-21 C range) used for the well's heat-loss calculation.
_assumptions.producer_well.parameters.esp.power_coeff: reused from the reference example's ESP power curve.
_assumptions.producer_well.parameters.esp.electricity: 0.3 kg CO2/kWh reused from the reference example.
_assumptions.producer_well.parameters.esp_freq_hz: 60 Hz; a common ESP drive frequency.
_assumptions.producer_well_calibration: reservoir_pressure_bar=216 bar was kept as given. productivity_index_m3h_per_bar was set to 1.76 m3/h/bar -- the value that reproduces the measured 125 m3/h primary flow at the measured 10 bar / 77 C wellhead conditions, with roughness_m left at the given 2e-5 m.
_assumptions.injector_well.parameters.productivity_in: set to 2.3 m3/h/bar -- the value that reproduces the measured ~44 bar injector wellhead pressure at the measured 125 m3/h flow, with reservoir_pressure_bar=180 bar kept as given/trusted and roughness_m left at 2e-5 m.
_assumptions.injector_well.parameters.roughness_m: 2e-5 m assumed the same tubing roughness as the producer well.
_assumptions.injector_well.parameters.injector_pump.e: 0.3 kg CO2/kWh reused from the reference example.
_assumptions.degasser.parameters: flow_resistance/temperature_drop/gas_water_ratio/gas_density reused from the reference example's separator parameters (a degasser is modeled with the same gas/liquid separation physics as a production separator).
_assumptions.filter_1.parameters, filter_2.parameters: reused from the reference example's FilterA/FilterB parameters.
_assumptions.hex_1/hex_2/hex_3.parameters (sizing, ca: heat_transfer_coefficient (UA, W/K) was calibrated to reproduce the measured ~70 C injector-inlet temperature at the real 125 m3/h flow: assuming the secondary side carries the same flow rate as the primary in each branch (capacity ratio Cr=1) at a 20 C supply temperature, the effectiveness needed to cool the primary side from 75 C (filter_1 outlet) to ~71 C (so that filter_2's 1 C drop lands on the measured 70 C) is only ~0.073, i.e. NTU=0.078. Results: hex_1 UA=6010 W/K, hex_2 UA=3606 W/K, hex_3 UA=2404 W/K (asymmetric, matching the 50/30/20 flow split).
_assumptions.hex_1/hex_2/hex_3 flow split: the primary flow is split asymmetrically 50/30/20 across hex_1/hex_2/hex_3 (three differently sized parallel units), matching each unit's UA sizing above.
_assumptions.hex_1/hex_2/hex_3 secondary side: not described in the plant layout. Secondary total flow is assumed equal to the real primary total flow (125.1 m3/h, split 50/30/20 same as primary) at a 20 C supply temperature.
_assumptions.filter_2.pressure (inlet): taken from hex_1's outlet pressure only, no flow resistance.

producer_well._description: Producer-side reservoir/well/ESP, nodal-solved for its primary flow rate from the fixed wellhead pressure/temperature boundary inputs below. See gemini_simulator.well_components.ProducerWell.

parameters._trajectory_table_description: Cumulative MD (measured depth)/TVD (true vertical depth)/ID (inner diameter) survey stations, station 0 = wellhead (MD=TVD=0). Equivalent deviation-angle-derived TVDs from the original angle/depth/diameter segments.

degasser._description: Degasser: separates the produced fluid's gas phase from the liquid before it reaches the filters, using the same gas/liquid separation physics as a production separator.

hex_splitter._description: Splits the primary flow unevenly across three differently-sized parallel heat exchangers (output_0/1/2 -> hex_1/hex_2/hex_3): hex_1 is the largest unit (50% of flow), hex_2 medium (30%), hex_3 smallest (20%).

hex_secondary_splitter._description: Splits a shared secondary-side supply across the three heat exchangers' secondary sides in the same proportion as their primary-side flow share (see hex_splitter), so each unit's secondary flow matches its size.

hex_1._description: Largest of the three parallel units (50% of primary/secondary flow).

hex_mixer._description: Recombines the three heat exchangers' primary-side outlets (flow + temperature) into a single flow/temperature, using a flow-weighted average of the three outlet temperatures.

injector_well._description: Injector-side reservoir/well, nodal-solved for the wellhead (surface) pressure needed to inject the producer well's (already-solved) flow rate back into the reservoir. See gemini_simulator.well_components.InjectorWell.

parameters._trajectory_table_description: Cumulative MD/TVD/ID survey stations, station 0 = wellhead (MD=TVD=0). Equivalent deviation-angle-derived TVDs from the original angle/depth/diameter segments.

boundary_inputs._description: Secondary-side supply flow, assumed equal to the total primary flow (125.1 m3/h -> 125.1/3600 m3/s), split with the same 50/30/20 fractions. See '_assumptions' above.
